notes.title: Demo Version of Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle! released today!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. The demo version of "Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle!" has been released today. Please try out the demo and if you have any feedbacks let us know. We will do our best to further improve the game.

[b]About Shachibato[/b]
An all-new Japanese SRPG based off “Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle!”.
Jump into battle with up to 5 teammates at once, featuring a 3D anime style and full 3D backgrounds!
As the president of a modern-day adventuring company, hire and train new warriors to send out and conquer dungeons in a unique and innovative character development system!
Randomly generated enemy groups and hidden treasure means infinite exploration!

[u]This game is currently still under development and it does not reflect the final product. We will continue to improve the game, so if you have any feedbacks please enter your feedback to the following form.[/u]
https://forms.gle/QzuMCnb37uLq4B1BA

[u]If you are experiencing any issues launching or playing the game, please fill out the following form.[/u]
https://forms.gle/ELpAPdvfWvDSCCmF6
